senses.gloss:
m. (-रः)
1 An object of sense, as sound, shape, colour, &c.
2 A country, a district.
3 The house or mansion of a planet, or its presence in any sign which is that of a person's nativity.
4 Pasturage.
E.
गो an organ of sense, &c. and चर what goes, from चर to go, घ aff.

n. (-र्म्म)
1 A cow's hide.
2 A hide of land, 300 feet long, by 10 broad: it is also defined as that extent of land, the crop of which will support a man for a year.
E.
गो, and चर्म्मन् skin.

m. (-कः)
A cowherd.
E.
गो, चर to go, causal form, वुन् aff.
